flags: Siteimprove completed its acquisition of MarketMuse on October 31, 2024, so compliance posture may still be aligning between parent and subsidiary.

Parent company Siteimprove holds ISO 27001:2022 certification, but MarketMuse does not independently claim this on its own site. It is unclear whether the certification extends to the MarketMuse product or covers only Siteimprove's corporate infrastructure.

MarketMuse does not publicly claim SOC 2 Type II certification on its own site. Parent company Siteimprove's DPA references sub-processors with SOC 2, but Siteimprove itself does not publicly claim SOC 2 on its website.

The privacy policy does not explicitly address whether customer content or data is used for AI model training. Ask the vendor to clarify its AI training practices and opt-out mechanisms before purchase.
Unlike many competitors, MarketMuse does not maintain a dedicated trust center or security page; compliance information is spread across the privacy policy and terms.

The Terms of Service reference Siteimprove's DPA rather than MarketMuse's own. This suggests operational dependency on the parent company's infrastructure but creates ambiguity about direct accountability.
